schema.description: Hierarchical CLI graph for the StackOps Typer-based CLI. Nodes capture command groups and leaf commands; aliases are stored on nodes rather than separate alias nodes.

node.name: CLI token for this node
node.fullPath: Space-separated command path excluding the root entry token
node.shortPath: Space-separated command path using the shortest alias token per segment when available
node.help: Command help string as registered on parent (if any)
node.doc: Docstring text for leaf commands or wrapper functions
node.aliases: List of alias objects with name/hidden/help/short_help
node.source: Where the callable or Typer app is defined
node.registered_in: Where the command was registered if different from source
node.command_context_settings: Typer context_settings used when registering the command
node.typer: Typer command configuration for leaf commands
node.signature: Structured signature object for leaf commands; includes raw_lines, parsed parameters, and return type.

notes: Graph derived from static source inspection of Typer app factories and lazy wrapper dispatchers.
Aliases are recorded on each node with hidden flags; no standalone alias nodes.
fullPath and shortPath are root-relative command strings, excluding the 'stackops' entry token.
Signature objects preserve raw lines while parsing Annotated/Option/Argument metadata into structured parameters.

typer.epilog:
Examples:
  devops vault rotate --source user --name github-personal
  devops vault rotate --name aws-dev --key AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  devops vault rotate --name aws-dev --input new-keys.json --json

Selection works as in devops vault load and must match exactly one bundle.
Without --input, hidden prompts ask for each key (only --key keys when given); leave one blank to keep it.
--input reads a JSON object of existing keys to new values from a file, or - for stdin.
Only existing keys are replaced, and rotation.lastRotated becomes today. Values are never printed.
Edit the secrets JSON directly to add keys or change labels.

children.name: scan
children.help:
🦠 <s> Scan installed apps or a single file path with VirusTotal.

Automatically uses configured VirusTotal accounts. --concurrency controls parallel files and defaults to the configured account count. Requests are serialized and spaced at least 15 seconds apart per account. Temporary failures receive bounded retries; inactive or invalid accounts are disabled and requests switch to another available account. --path uses the same retry and account-switching rules. Existing reports are retrieved by SHA256 with their original analysis date; unknown files are submitted for analysis. Cloud uploads are disabled by default. --upload (-u) uploads each file after its VirusTotal check completes, including --path scans, to myhome/security/<os>/<home-relative-directory>/<app>/<sha256>/<filename> without overwriting previous copies. The final report includes request and failure statistics by account name, without API keys. Every scan records a separate run, including file scans; --no-record opts out. Results are saved as files finish. Use --all to scan all installed apps, history to list runs, report --run ID to inspect a run, and export --run ID --output DIR for CSV files. Scan failures cause a nonzero exit.

children.doc:
🔄 UPDATE uv and stackops

Assets are copied by default; --no-copy-assets skips copying.
Post-update actions:
Copy scripts and settings unless --no-copy-assets is passed.
--sync-configs        -> devops config dotfiles sync down --source library --method copy --on-conflict overwrite-default-path --which all
--config-shell        -> devops config terminal config-shell --shell default

--dev is a pre-update action (requires a repo checkout):
--dev                -> commit local changes, git pull --rebase, git push (stops safely on any failure)

children.name: run
children.help:
Launch selected layouts from a layout configuration file.

Use --on-conflict to choose behavior when a target session already exists:
error, restart, rename, merge-overwrite, or
merge-skip. Those two merge policies are
supported for tmux, TUIOS, and Zellij.
Use `run-all` for the paced whole-file dynamic scheduler.

The type of parallelization here is constrained by layouts. It asumes that every layout is a self-contained unit that must be launched in its entirety before the next one is launched, but multiple layouts can be launched at the same time if --parallel-layouts is set. If you want to launch every tab as soon as possible without waiting for the whole layout to launch, use `run-all` instead.

typer.Option("--source", "-s", help="Layout sources: workspace/w, user/u, or all/a. Used when --custom-path is omitted."),

test_layout: Annotated[bool, typer.Option(..., "--test-layout", "-L", help="Generate a built-in mock layout with many finite tabs for experimenting with run and run-all. Cannot be used with --custom-path.")] = False,

choose_layouts: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(..., "--choose-layouts", "-l", metavar="[NAMES]", help="Comma separated layout names. Use -l without a value to select layouts interactively.")] = None,

choose_tabs: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(..., "--choose-tabs", "-t", metavar="[NAMES]", help="Comma separated tab names. Use -t without a value to select tabs interactively from all layouts, or from layouts selected with -l.")] = None,
sleep_inbetween: Annotated[float, typer.Option(..., "--launch-delay", "-S", help="Delay in seconds between launching layouts")] = 1.0,
max_tabs: Annotated[int, typer.Option(..., "--max-tabs-per-layout", "-T", help="A Sanity checker that throws an error if any layout exceeds the maximum number of tabs to launch.")] = 25,
max_layouts: Annotated[int, typer.Option(..., "--max-parallel-layouts", "-P", help="A Sanity checker that throws an error if the total number of *parallel layouts exceeds this number.")] = 25,
monitor: Annotated[bool, typer.Option(..., "--monitor", "-m", help="Monitor the layout sessions for completion (implied by --parallel-layouts)")] = False,
parallel_layouts: Annotated[int | None, typer.Option(..., "--parallel-layouts", "-j", help="Maximum number of layouts to launch per monitored batch. 1 behaves like sequential mode.")] = None,

backend: Annotated[SessionMultiplexerOption | None, typer.Option("--backend", "-b", help=f"Session multiplexer: tmux/t, herdr/h, tuios/u, aoe/e, or zellij/z (Zellij 0.45+). {DEFAULT_SESSION_MULTIPLEXER_HELP}")] = None,

on_conflict: Annotated[_SessionConflictActionLoose, typer.Option("--on-conflict", "-c", help="How to handle existing session name conflicts. merge-overwrite and merge-skip are supported for tmux, TUIOS, and Zellij.")] = "error",
exit_mode: Annotated[Literal["back-to-shell", "terminate", "kill-window"], typer.Option("--exit", "-e", help="What each tab/window should do after its command exits.")] = "back-to-shell",

subsitute_home: Annotated[bool, typer.Option(..., "--substitute-home", "-H", help="Substitute ~ and $HOME in layout file with actual home directory path")] = False,

attach: Annotated[bool, typer.Option(..., "--attach", "-a", help="Attach to the first launched session after launching (tmux, TUIOS, and Zellij). Cannot be used with --monitor, --parallel-layouts, or --kill-upon-completion.")] = False,

children.name: run-all
children.help:
Run every tab from every layout in a layout configuration file at a controlled pace.
New tab kicks in as soon as another tab finishes, keeping the total number of active tabs under the specified maximum.
Use this if problem is embarresingly parallel and is only constrained by resources.

children.name: status
children.help:
Inspect live agents across local TUIOS or Herdr sessions, including detached sessions and background workspaces, or the current AoE profile. Collect reported states, read-only evidence and reliably linked retained transcripts. Never contacts agents or changes their panes; history gaps and unverified task completion remain explicit.

Filters use terminal layout conventions: layout > tab > pane. TUIOS: session > workspace > window; Herdr: workspace > tab > pane; AoE: group > session > one runtime. --session selects the native manager session. Names and IDs match exactly, case-sensitively. Repeat a filter for alternatives; different filters combine with AND. Duplicate names select all matches: narrow with --session/--layout/--tab or use IDs.

raw_lines: backend: Annotated[AgentStatusBackend | None, typer.Option("--backend", "-b", help=f"Agent backend to inspect: tuios, herdr, aoe or t3. AoE uses its current profile. t3 reads unsettled threads on the local T3 Code server; it has no sessions, layouts, tabs or panes, so --session, --layout, --tab, --pane, --exclude-pane and --server are rejected and --lines does not apply. {DEFAULT_AGENT_MULTIPLEXER_HELP}")] = None,

session: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Option("--session", "-s", help="Native manager session name or ID; Herdr's outer session, TUIOS session, or AoE session in the current profile. Default: all live local sessions, including detached sessions. Repeat for alternatives.")] = None,
layout: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Option("--layout", "-l", help="Layout scope: TUIOS session name/ID; Herdr workspace label/ID/number; AoE full group path. Repeat for alternatives.")] = None,
tab: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Option("--tab", "-t", help="Layout tab: TUIOS workspace name/number; Herdr tab label/ID; AoE session title/ID. Repeat for alternatives.")] = None,

window: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Option("--pane", "-p", help="Layout pane: TUIOS window name/ID; Herdr pane label/title/ID; AoE session title/ID (one runtime per tab). Repeat for alternatives.")] = None,
exclude_window: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Option("--exclude-pane", "-x", help="Pane name or ID to omit, using the same mapping as --pane. Repeat as needed.")] = None,

agent_session: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Option("--agent-session", "-A", help="Reported agent name or conversation ID, when available: TUIOS registered name (also pane name), Herdr agent name, AoE session title/ID. Repeat for alternatives.")] = None,
harness: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Option("--harness", "-a", help="Agent harness to include; repeat as needed. 'claude' is an alias for 'claude-code'.")] = None,

state: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Option("--state", "-S", help="Filter working, waiting, blocked, idle, completed, failed, unknown or unavailable; repeat as needed. completed also matches tasks reported completed while their live agents are idle.")] = None,
include_self: Annotated[bool, typer.Option("--include-self", "-i", help="Include the observer's own pane. Default: exclude it using pane/process identity.")] = False,
history: Annotated[HistoryMode, typer.Option("--history", "-H", help="auto: use available linked transcripts, AoE structured history or supported hooks; none: skip history.")] = "auto",

lines: Annotated[int, typer.Option("--lines", "-n", min=0, help="Lines to capture per agent. TUIOS and AoE tmux include scrollback; Herdr includes retained scrollback only for idle agents without a linked transcript (its scrollback reads are slow), otherwise the visible viewport; AoE ACP workers have no pane. 0 captures all TUIOS scrollback, Herdr's default retained output or the AoE viewport.")] = 200,
messages: Annotated[int, typer.Option("--messages", "-m", min=0, help="Newest retained human/context messages per agent, in chronological order. 0 keeps all available messages.")] = 0,
text_limit: Annotated[int, typer.Option("--text-limit", "-T", min=0, help="Character limit per message or evidence text. Truncation is marked. 0 keeps full text.")] = 8000,
server: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option("--server", "-d", help="Named local TUIOS daemon to inspect. Default: TUIOS's current/default daemon.")] = None,

output_format: Annotated[StatusFormat, typer.Option("--format", "-f", help="Output format: table, rich (styled overview and agent cards), json or markdown. JSON includes structured evidence and extracted history subject to the requested limits. File output has no ANSI colours.")] = "table",
json_output: Annotated[bool, typer.Option("--json", "-j", help="Print structured JSON; shorthand for --format json.")] = False,
output: Annotated[Path | None, typer.Option("--output", "-o", dir_okay=False, help="Write the report to a private file instead of stdout. Existing files require --force.")] = None,
force: Annotated[bool, typer.Option("--force", "-F", help="Allow replacing an existing --output file; agent sessions are never modified.")] = False,

btw: Annotated[bool, typer.Option("--btw", "-w", help="By the way: also ask each shown agent two side questions, its status and what it is working on, in a fork that leaves its main conversation untouched. Claude Code uses a non-persisted --fork-session without tools; Codex uses an ephemeral read-only exec fork; T3 Code forks the thread's latest completed run and archives the fork. Other harnesses, or agents without a linked conversation, report the side question as unavailable. Forks use model turns and can take minutes.")] = False,
